description: Use this to see which organizations the person let this app use: each one's id, name, role, plan, card on file and fax numbers. Pass an id as organization to the inbox tools, create_fax and get_faxes. An empty list means the person selected none when connecting; they can reconnect the app to choose. Needs the person to sign in to Faxette. It changes nothing.
name: get_organizations

card.description: The card on file, held for a fax the plan doesn't cover. Null without one.

fax_numbers.description: The organization's fax numbers, where its inbox receives faxes.

id.description: Pass it as organization to the tools that act for this organization.

plan.description: The organization's plan, which pays for its faxes when it covers them. Null without a plan.

title: List organizations
